markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (93%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class set [F1] and medial margin call (108 um) [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 93%, InSitu 6%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | High invasive score (5% ECE) |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90% coverage, alpha 0.1) | Single class, 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% (0.977), OOD 1.0, 12/12 kept [F6] | High reliability, atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True | Backbones agree on top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 (80%) Invasive [F5]; BACH_0077 InSitu (0.701) | Neighbors mostly match Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.471) opposes invasive (19/20 check) [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Score (+0.427) favors invasive (0/20 check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.421) favors invasive (0/20 check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.364) favors invasive (18/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses unreliable lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section blur (severity 3) obscures ducts, mimicking Invasive over InSitu (BACH_0077, similarity 0.701).
- Validated invasion is low (-0.471), while HoVer-Net cells and stain orders are disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8**: Highest risk (99%–100%) and medial margin call (108 um, region 4).
2. **Regions 5, 8, 9**: Verify mitoses and necrosis; both concept scores are unreliable (0/20, 3/20).
3. **Regions 1, 7, 11**: Check invasion (region 11) vs InSitu (region 1) and tubules (region 7).

found: 'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).
The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
